question: To what kind of person is this teaching to be given?
premises: A teaching is to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: Transmission is enjoined only to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: What 'all states' means is not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
